title: Emerald Ash Borer Information Request
description: Use this service request to report ash trees potentially infested with Emerald Ash Borers and/or to request information about Emerald Ash Borer management. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: What is the nature of your request?

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a possible emerald ash borer infestation.
actions.why: Report an ash tree that may be infested with emerald ash borers or request information about emerald ash borer management. The 311 request form accepts trees on public or private property, asks for the tree’s location, and distinguishes a possible infestation from an information request.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Tree Concerns" > Choose "Emerald Ash Borer Information Request"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Tree Concerns" > Choose "Emerald Ash Borer Information Request"
